title: Mealtime Habits for Kids! Breakfast, Lunch and More with Pip
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Pip the strawberry, and this is my buddy Kiko the broccoli!
Welcome to Fruity Friends! Today we're learning five fun habits for mealtime and snack time.
Can you count with me? One, two, three, four, five!
Yummy food and healthy habits help us grow, play and learn every day.
Ready? Let's go to the kitchen and find out!

lines: Here's a clue: it's the very first meal of the day, in the morning! Can you guess?
This is Breakfast! Can you say breakfast?
We sleep all night long. In the morning, breakfast gives us energy to play and learn.
Breakfast can be oatmeal with berries, toast, eggs, yogurt or fruit.
Can you stretch and say good morning? Arms up, big smile! Good morning!
In the morning, after we wake up!
One more time, nice and loud: BREAKFAST!
Every family has its own favorite breakfast. What's yours?
Here's a clue: we rinse fruits and veggies with water before we eat them! Can you guess?
This is washing our food! Can you say wash?
First, wash your hands. Then a grown-up helps rinse the fruits and veggies under running water.
We rub them gently with our hands. Just water, no soap!
Can you pretend to rinse an apple? Rub, rub, rub, under the water!
Why do we wash fruits and veggies?
To wash away dirt and germs, so they're clean and ready!
One more time, nice and loud: WASH!
Clean food and clean hands make snack time even better.
Here's a clue: we put yummy food in a box to take with us! Can you guess?
This is packing a lunch! Can you say lunch?
A packed lunch can have a fruit, a veggie, a sandwich and water.
A little cool pack helps keep the food fresh until lunchtime.
Can you help pack a pretend lunch? Apple in, carrots in, sandwich in, close the lid!
What's a good drink to pack?
Water! In a bottle you can fill again.
One more time, nice and loud: LUNCH!
You can help choose what goes in your lunchbox. That's a fun job!
Here's a clue: it's when we taste something we never tasted before! Can you guess?
This is trying new foods! Can you say try it?
Trying a new food is like a little adventure for your mouth.
Start with a tiny taste. Is it crunchy? Soft? Sweet? Sour?
Can you pretend to take a tiny taste? Nibble, nibble! Hmm!
What if you don't like it the first time?
That's okay! Sometimes we like a food after trying it a few times.
Let's say it together: TRY IT!
One more time, nice and loud: TRY IT!
Every tiny taste helps you learn about a new food.
Here's a clue: it's a place outside where farmers sell the food they grew! Can you guess?
This is the farmers market! Can you say market?
At the farmers market, farmers bring fruits and veggies from their farms.
You can see what's growing right now, like apples in fall or berries in summer.
Can you carry a pretend basket? Pick a red one, a green one, an orange one!
What do we say to the farmer?
One more time, nice and loud: MARKET!
Bring a bag, and pick one new fruit or veggie to try.

recap: Yummy! Let's remember what we learned.
Wash fruits and veggies with water.
Pack a lunch to take along.
Try a tiny taste of something new.
outro: Which one was your favorite? Tell a grown-up, and try something new this week!
Bye, friends! See you next time on Fruity Friends!
